name: Boyfriends And Girlfriends
overview: Scripture teaches that romantic relationships must honor God's commandments and reflect His design for marriage. Loving Christ involves obedience to His commands, which includes faithfulness and purity, as adultery is described as lacking understanding and self-destructive. The Bible also reveals that the intended union between a man and a woman is a lifelong covenant where they become one flesh, emphasizing the sacredness and permanence of the marital bond.
